title: You Are Already Blessed
description: In this powerful sermon, Pastor Chris Zehner reminds us that no matter what challenges we're facing, God's blessings are already upon us. With a message of hope and encouragement, Pastor Chris teaches us that we are blessed, not cursed, and that God's redemption is a done deal. Don't miss this inspiring sermon that will leave you feeling empowered and equipped to face whatever comes your way.
